summary: In at least UK populations, and perhaps others, SNP rs2187668 is a tag SNP for the HLA-DRB1*0301 allele. }} A high-resolution linkage-disequilibrium map of the human major histocompatibility complex and first generation of tag single-nucleotide polymorphisms. }} Newly identified genetic risk variants for celiac disease related to the immune response. }} Genome-wide association analysis by lasso penalized logistic regression. }} No association of multiple type 2 diabetes loci with type 1 diabetes. }} Mapping of multiple susceptibility variants within the MHC region for 7 immune-mediated diseases.
